summary: publish.yml's exact-SHA replay guard misreads npm's E404-on-stdout as an existing publication, so the FIRST publish of any version refuses itself — v0.36.0 tag failed CI and never reached the registry
evidence: gh run 32394971095 log: existing resolved to the tr-squashed string {error:{code:E404,summary:Nomatchfoundforversion0.36.0,...}} and the guard exited 1 with 'already exists from <that garbage>, not tagged commit 269b216'; npm view with --json prints E404 as JSON on STDOUT while the script silenced only stderr and swallowed the exit code with || true; registry still serves 0.35.0
